FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (16)

Try searching with another word or reset filters to browse all categories.

You remain invisible to all nearby members until you intentionally start a discovery session. Each session requires choosing a clear networking goal and duration (30 min, 1 hour, or 2 hours). When time expires, you automatically return to invisible mode.

Never. Peopi calculates approximate proximity within a randomized radius. Exact coordinates are never broadcast to other users, shared with third parties, or logged on servers.

Hide Presence: Selectively conceals your live discovery status from that connection while preserving your connection, profile, and chat. The contact is never notified.

Block: Completely removes the connection, revokes messaging, and prevents them from appearing in discovery or finding you.

Your live beacon powers down and you disappear from nearby radar immediately. Ongoing chats and established connections remain untouched in your Connections tab. You can extend by +30 min before time expires.

When you discover someone nearby or in the list view, tap Request to connect. You can choose your networking intent and add an optional personal note (up to 140 characters). Once sent, the recipient receives a private invitation.

Direct messaging unlocks only after the recipient accepts your connection request. Strangers cannot cold-message you in discovery without mutual acceptance.

When meeting in person at an event or cafe, quick prompt chips (such as "Coffee nearby? ☕", "Where are you? 📍", or "Free for 15m ⏱️") allow coordinating meeting spots instantly with one tap.

Yes. Open the connection's detail screen, tap the three dots (···) in the top-right corner, and select Remove connection. Alternatively, use Hide presence if you wish to stay connected without appearing in their nearby radar.

Open the member's profile or tap the three dots (···) inside your chat, then tap Report user. Select a reason (Spam, Harassment, Impersonation, or Inappropriate profile) and submit. Reports are handled confidentially within 24 hours.

Blocking immediately terminates active conversations, removes the connection, and permanently hides each person from the other's radar and search results. The blocked user receives no notification.

No. Peopi is dedicated to genuine professional relationships and idea exchange. Hard sales pitches, automated bot outreach, affiliate marketing, and crypto solicitation violate our Community Guidelines and result in account termination.

Always arrange first meetings in public, populated spaces such as open cafes, hotel lobbies, or conference lounges. Share approximate location only, and feel free to end sessions or go invisible anytime with one tap.

Connecting LinkedIn confirms account ownership with a verified badge signal on your profile. Peopi never scrapes your LinkedIn contacts, never reads your private messages, and never posts to your LinkedIn feed.

Only confirmed connections can view and download attached documents like CV/Resume, One Pager, or Portfolios. Strangers browsing nearby discovery only see locked document count placeholders.

Go to Profile > Edit profile. From there you can update your headline, city, bio, manage up to 8 skill tags, add past work experiences with dates, and upload new documents.

Your profile strength score increases as you add complete information: photo, headline, bio, intent, skills, work experience, and verified LinkedIn connection. A higher score improves response rates during discovery.

Still need assistance?Our member support and trust team is here.

Response time is typically under 24 hours. Inquiries are strictly confidential.

Peopi is a verified professional space. Harassment, spam, and solicitation are strictly prohibited.

Privacy Policy

PROJECT OVERVIEW

What is Peopi?

Peopi is a privacy-first mobile discovery environment designed for spontaneous, intentional, and verified in-person networking.

24 Interactive screens
4 User flows
8 Component families
100% Privacy control

Core Value Proposition & Promise

Purposeful, consented in-person introductions instead of endless feeds, noisy notifications, and superficial connections.

From Invisible to Active Discovery

No continuous background location tracking. Proximity discovery runs only during an active session and stops automatically when the timer expires.

Spontaneous Coffee & Ideation Chats

Meet fellow professionals in conferences, airports, co-working hubs, or events who are open to introducing themselves.

Mutual Consent & Trust

Connections require double opt-in. Unaccepted requests disappear silently without awkward social friction.

PROJECT OVERVIEW

Problem & Opportunity

Traditional professional networks and proximity apps fail to serve spontaneous real-world connections safely.

The Current Gaps
  • Social feeds are detached from physical presence and cluttered with noise.
  • Location-based apps compromise privacy or cater to dating.
  • Event encounters remain entirely left to chance.
The Peopi Opportunity
  • Ephemeral, consented sessions with zero ambient privacy anxiety.
  • Clear networking intent filters (Coffee chat, Mentorship, Collaboration).
  • Only members present in the room and currently active are discoverable.
PROJECT OVERVIEW

Audience & Use Cases

Who uses Peopi, in which physical settings, and for what concrete networking moments?

Conferences & Summits

Instantly spot relevant domain peers, founders, or investors in keynote halls and initiate quick coffee introductions without awkwardness.

Co-working & Shared Hubs

Spark serendipitous collaboration between indie builders, designers, and remote teams working under the same roof.

Business Travel & Lounges

Transform layover hours in airport lounges or visiting new cities into high-value professional exchanges.

PROJECT OVERVIEW

How Peopi Works

From invisible by default to active discovery and mutual chat in four clear, privacy-first steps.

1. Invisible State & Session Setup

Members are completely invisible by default. When ready to network, pick an intent (e.g., Coffee chat) and duration (30m, 1h) to go visible.

2. Proximity Discovery & Radar

Only people currently active in the venue appear on radar or list view. Shows approximate distance and shared background tags.

3. Connection Request & Mutual Opt-In

Send an introduction request with an optional note. Direct chat is locked until the recipient accepts. Declined requests leave no awkward trail.

4. Ephemeral Chat & Auto-Close

Accepted requests unlock direct messaging to coordinate a meetup spot. Once the session timer expires, discovery turns off automatically.

PROJECT OVERVIEW

Product Scope & Rules

MVP feature boundaries, profile requirements, privacy invariants, and platform rules.

MVP Scope
  • Lightweight OTP authentication and essential profile setup.
  • Proximity radar and list discovery for concurrent active sessions.
  • Double opt-in introduction requests with ephemeral 1:1 chat.
  • Experience timeline, verified LinkedIn badge, and PDF portfolio attachments.
Privacy & Safety Invariants
  • Exact GPS coordinates and live movement trails are never exposed; only coarse distance bands.
  • No passive or ambient background tracking; sessions auto-terminate on timer expiry.
  • Attached documents (CV, portfolio) are only visible after an introduction is mutually accepted.
  • One-tap hide and block controls immediately sever mutual visibility and messaging.
